data.text: Swap places with the enemy you Attack (walk over them and go behind): you take their hex and they take yours. Negate the enemy's Move. Alt: the enemy or ally is moved one tile away; step over them.

logic.description: Instant riding on an Attack card against an enemy in contact. The target's Move this round is negated (they stay on their tile) and — paper swap implemented (user ruling 2026-11-16) — when the Attack targets that adjacent enemy the attacker and the enemy swap places (walk over them and go behind): each takes the other's hex after the moves, if neither moved otherwise this action; one swap per unit and action (actor order). The Alt (push one tile away) is still not implemented. Judged by whether it did its job (negated a Move or swapped); with nothing to do it returns to hand.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is an Attack card.
The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: True when the target's Move / Empty Move is cancelled this round (target in contact and playing M or EM).
1 when the attacker and the adjacent enemy target trade hexes this action.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.
